title: Roaming legendaries
description: The roaming legendaries (docs/paperwhite2/design/roaming-legendaries.md): how they move, then one entry per roamer, at most 8 (the save's slots), in their ROAMER_* order. tools/paperwhite2/roamers.py checks the file with routes.json beside it and writes paperwhite2/roamers_config.h for src/paperwhite2/ov012/paperwhite2_roamers.c and the scripts.

move_minutes.description: The real-time minutes (the clock's) a roamer stays on a route before it moves to a neighbouring one; the clock pauses while the player is on its route

offline_moves_max.description: The most moves a roamer makes for the time counted at once: with the game off, or a long stay on one map

scatter_links.description: After a battle it leaves (it fled, the player ran or lost), a roamer moves at once at least this many links away

groups.description: The groups that a script releases together, by name: ROAMER_GROUP_<NAME> in the header, in this order

name.description: Its ROAMER_<NAME> in the header and the scripts

odds.description: The percent of the step encounters on its route that are it, for its methods (the original's 50)

methods.description: How it is met: walk (grass, dark grass, cave floors), surf, fish. Only the routes of routes.json with a step rate for one of them in the wild encounters' data are its routes

weather.description: The field weather of its route while it is there, over the weather calendar: snow is the field's light snow (WEATHER_FLAKE), hail its heavier snow (WEATHER_BLIZZARD). harsh_sun is a later phase's new weather and gives none for now

routes.description: The routes of routes.json it roams, by place; all of them when absent
